description: The ordered record of an agent run: every model response with its usage and every tool call with its arguments and outcome.
Checks the result of an agent run: the final answer or, better, the final state of the environment.
Checks the path: required and forbidden tools, order constraints, argument policies, step and cost limits.
One exact expected sequence of calls. Brittle, because agents take many valid paths; prefer properties.
"A before B" without requiring B immediately after A, such as a successful lookup before any refund.
A call to an allowed tool with arguments outside policy, such as a refund above the approval threshold.
The probability that all k attempts at a task succeed. It measures reliability, and falls fast for agents that only usually behave.
